name: @ice-examples/desk-clock
description: A THIRD-PARTY desk kind in its own package (design-016 K8b · K-L2): an analogue desk clock drawn by its own WGSL, with durable props, a registered wake, a tray entry, a menu act, an opening with its own held tools, a chip inside a mini mat and a round face to pick — built on the umbrella's PUBLISHED entries alone (`@vibecook/ice`, `/kernel`, `/desk`, `/desk/kit`, `/desk/engine`), exactly as a VibeField plugin will be. Never published: apps/desk registers it and the oracle draws its scenes.
